blocks.text: Get 5G Speed and All-Day Power Without compromise Upgrade your mobile experience with the TCL T513 5G for Verizon. This smartphone is engineered to deliver the features you need, starting with blazing-fast 5G connectivity that lets you stream, download, and game at incredible speeds. A Display That Pulls You In Your entertainment comes to life on the massive 6.75-inch HD+ display. Powered by TCL's exclusive NXTVISION technology, you'll see richer colors and deeper contrast, making every video and photo look its best. The expansive screen gives you more room to browse, play, and share. A Battery That Keeps Going Forget battery anxiety. The powerful 5010mAh battery is designed to last, giving you the confidence to tackle your day (and night) without being tethered to a charger. From long video calls to movie marathons, the TCL T513 is built to keep up. Capture Your World Be ready for any moment with the versatile 13MP dual-camera system. Take sharp, detailed photos or use the depth lens to create beautiful, blurred-background portraits. With 64GB of internal storage, you have the room to save all your precious memories. This device is locked to the Verizon network, giving you access to America's most reliable coverage. Activation is simple and can be done online in minutes

items.label: Carrier
items.value: This phone is locked to Verizon, which means this device can only be used on the Verizon wireless network. A Verizon plan is required to activate this device. Activating is easy, upon receipt go to the Verizon Website and select “Activate” and follow the prompts. **NOTE NOT COMPATIBLE WITH VERIZON POSTPAID**

items: BLAZING-FAST 5G SPEED – Experience the power of 5G on Verizon's nationwide network. Stream your favorite movies, enjoy lag-free gaming, and download large files in seconds with an affordable smartphone built for speed.

MASSIVE ALL-DAY BATTERY – Power through your day and night without searching for an outlet. The robust 5010mAh battery is built for endurance, giving you the freedom to talk, text, stream, and browse for hours on a single charge.

IMMERSIVE 6.75" HD+ DISPLAY – Get lost in a cinematic viewing experience on the expansive 6.75-inch HD+ display. Featuring NXTVISION technology, this screen delivers vibrant colors and sharp details, making it perfect for watching videos, browsing photos, or scrolling social media.

CAPTURE CLEAR PHOTOS & STORE MORE – Snap clear photos with the 13MP main camera and 2MP depth lens for artistic portrait shots. With 64GB of internal storage, expandable up to 1TB with a microSD card (sold separately), you’ll have plenty of space for all your apps, photos, and files.
